en: ...This is a ladies' hat shop, isn't it?
I may not look it, but I am a man.
But I truly think they would suit you
ever so well.
The pink lace is just adorable.
Among fine ladies and young noblewomen,
our hats are very popular, you know.
Why, the famed beauty... the Epstein family's
Miss Rose loves our hats too.
I simply must have you wear
a certain dress for me.
As I keep telling you, I'm a man!
When it comes to beauty, man or woman
makes no difference...
When it comes to wearing a dress, it does
make a difference, I'd think...
Please, I beg you.
Just once, won't you try on a dress
for me...?
No, I must politely decline.
Please come again tomorrow.
I'll be waiting for you tomorrow.
I've already closed the shop...
If there's a hat you like,
I'll gladly set it aside for you.

en: a killer who slashes folk. Have you heard?
Seems the bodies get carved up with a knife,
and folk have given the killer a nickname:
"Jack the Ripper."
With a murderer like that on the prowl,
I'm too scared to set foot outside at night.
That knife murderer still hasn't been caught,
it seems.
What on earth are the police doing?
Hopeless, the lot of 'em!
Just how frightened us common folk are -
I bet they've no idea.
Oh my, I've gone and got carried away.
Do buy a drop of something before you go.
Say, sir, have you heard?
Lady Rose, Count Epstein's daughter.
She's ever so beautiful, she is.
What sort of man will end up marrying her,
I wonder.
Every notable in London wants to take her
as his bride, from what I hear...
Lady Rose of the Epstein family - a beauty
like her, I've never seen in all my days.
